body: HOLD: independent safety review in progress at 353db74; do not merge until it posts. The coordinator checks the automatic Arc dead-end ramp on a plain Outside pocket against the maintainer's rule on #3741: an Outside pass never uses a helix or ramp entry, and the tool goes down in air outside the stock.

Review rework pushed. The head is `6e381cc81d4a70aec8bb28c955b5c88c39725223`. It answers the HOLD and the needs-rework finding: an Outside pass never uses a helix or ramp entry (#3741).

Change:
- The op now refuses a selected Arc on an Outside ring pass (Waterline, Offset rings) that has no air room. The refusal has a name: `OUTSIDE_AIR_REFUSAL`, "entry refused: no air room for an Outside entry: set a stock, or choose an Inside start or a Helix, Ramp or Plunge entry". The check runs before the ladder (`entry_warn::refuse_outside_arc`, from `pocket.rs` and `pocket_avoid.rs`). The op posts no automatic ramp or helix.
- A selected Helix, Ramp or Plunge runs as selected. It has its one `EntryNotRecommended` warning (#3748). The advice note is now written on each Inside or Outside ring pass, also when there is no air room.
- `PlungeIntoStock` stays. The op posts it only where it posts no `EntryNotRecommended` for the Plunge. Thus the op names the Plunge one time.
- `EntryStandIn` and the `warning:` status lines stay for the stand-ins that remain: Inside with no air room, and a restart where no air lead fits.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3884-start-side-entry-warnings.md` records the refusal and what was dropped.
- Merged `origin/main` plainly.

Pins (`camcraft-motion` `pass_start_engagement`):
- `outside_pocket_arc_without_air_is_refused`: the band pocket with no stock and Arc gives the named refusal and no path. This pin does not compile on main, because main has no refusal. On main the same case posts 8 ramps.
- `outside_pocket_selected_entry_keeps_one_warning`: Plunge (more than one plunge) and Ramp run as selected. Each has exactly one warning that names it.
- The UI pin `each_stand_in_entry_is_a_warning_line` did not change.

Results on this head (`CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`, -j 6):
- `pass_start_engagement`: 8 passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 326 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (58.4 min).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --only "app heavy: pocket_pass_start"`: ok (184 s).
- `app heavy: offset_pass_start`: not run again on this head. It was ok on 353db74.
HOLD: independent safety review in progress at 6e381cc; do not merge until it posts.

Safety review rework is pushed. The head is `3011c452dc4991b7cd96f955987950d4d44944fd` (origin/main merged plainly). It answers review 6043099439 with one rule: a selected Arc on an Outside ring pass goes down in air outside the stock, or the op is refused by name (`OUTSIDE_AIR_REFUSAL`). The check is one function, `entry_warn::outside_air_check`, and every Outside entry path calls it.

Findings and fixes:
1. **Re-entry after a lift** (`descent_dive.rs` `entry_restart`): `entry_warn::outside_arc_restart` now runs first. It tries the air lead. If no air lead fits, it returns `Descent::Refused`, with no ramp or helix. The non-centre-cutting `restart` calls it too. Pin: `air_entry::tests::outside_reentry_without_an_air_lead_is_refused`.
2. **First entry with no air lead** (`air_entry.rs` `stand_in`): an Outside pass now returns `Descent::Refused` at once. Inside keeps its named stand-in. Pin: `air_entry::tests::outside_first_entry_without_an_air_lead_is_refused`.
3. **Adaptive ring fallback**: the plan-level refusal no longer skips Adaptive. The advice note still skips it. Pin: `pass_start_engagement::outside_pocket_arc_without_air_is_refused` now covers Waterline, Offset rings and Adaptive.
- `approach::refusal` now reads `OUTSIDE_AIR_REFUSAL`, so a ladder refusal fails the op by name.
- The clamp pin `avoid_route_entry_plunges_in_air_clear_of_a_clamp` now accepts a move off the clamp in air or the named refusal. It no longer accepts a stand-in.
- Notes from the review: the Ramp pin comment now says why `EntryStandIn` is not counted. The decision file says that Zigzag is not checked, because its rows have no start side.
- All pins are red on main, because they do not compile there (`OUTSIDE_AIR_REFUSAL`).

Results on this head (`CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`, -j 6):
- `air_entry` lib tests: 10 passed.
- `pass_start_engagement`: 8 passed.
- `pocket_pass_start` (debug): 5 passed, 2 ignored.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 326 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- clippy (motion, sim, app, ui): clean.
- `app heavy: pocket_pass_start`: ok.
- **`app heavy: offset_pass_start`: FAIL, 3 tests.** These are `fig8_start_sides_enter_from_the_air`, `fig8_outside_offset_has_no_plunge_into_material` and `entry_advice::fig8_outside_selected_helix_warns_once_and_arc_not_at_all`. The fig8 2D Offset Outside op with Arc is now refused:
  `entry refused: no air room for an Outside entry: ... (the pass start (-7.926, -33.062) at Z 12.000 is in material and no air lead reaches it)`.
  This is the #3825 case, as `3746-air-entry.md` describes it. Four pass links lift across the part to a start inside ring 0. Those re-entries plunged into material (named) before. The new rule refuses them.

**A decision is necessary before this PR can be ready:**
- (A) Accept the refusal of fig8 Outside with Arc until #3825 fixes the pass links. Change the three fig8 tests to expect the named refusal, or mark them known-fail on #3825.
- (B) Keep the named plunge for this re-entry until #3825 is fixed.

Recommended: (A). It follows the #3741 rule and the Prime Directive. But the op on the main fig8 example then posts no program. The PR stays draft and is not ready.

Refresh of the branch with `main`.

- The new head is `6fe046daf6035962c10a58612b8716e1877a78b0`.
- It is a merge commit of `ddb2986f41fc948cd974f576bb6cbe287bf0a9bd` and `main` at `3b4c4b2cb8d48d9442466b23e49f1962d38b4f6d`.
- The push was a plain fast-forward push. The PR is still a draft.

The merge had two conflicts. I resolved each one by hand. The class is DELTA. Each side added arms to the same `Warning` list, and the resolution is the union of the two sides.

1. `crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs`, `Warning::blocks_post`: the advisory list now has `PlungeTooDeep` (from `main`), `EntryNotRecommended` (the two sides), `EntryStandIn` and `PlungeIntoStock` (from the branch).
2. `crates/ui/src/operations.rs`, `fold_warnings_located` / `last_move`: one arm list now has `PlungeTooDeep { at, .. }`, `EntryNotRecommended { at, .. }`, `EntryStandIn { at, .. }` and `PlungeIntoStock { at }`, with `=> *at`.

No arm was removed. No other file has a hand edit. `git show --remerge-diff 6fe046daf` shows only these two hunks.

Build check: `cargo check -j 6 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets` passed on the new head. No other `match` on `Warning` needed a new arm.

No test ran on this head. The gate and the fresh safety review are still owed; the head moved, so earlier results do not count.
